name: Cable Concentration Triceps Extension
steps: Half-kneel facing a high pulley and brace your working upper arm against the inside of your raised thigh with the handle close to your chest.
Straighten your elbow to move the handle down alongside your shin.
Let your elbow bend and guide the handle back up.
Switch sides and repeat the movement.
tips: Keep your braced upper arm completely still so movement comes strictly from the elbow.
Keep your torso tall and avoid rocking forward to push the handle down.
